story.festival_halloween.name: Halloween
story.festival_halloween.desc: A Halloween challenge: bring in sixty pumpkins and carve a few lanterns.
story.festival_halloween.ch.c1.sum: Pumpkins grow around you on the green worlds during Halloween week. Harvest sixty of them.
story.festival_halloween.r1.start: Halloween week! On the green worlds pumpkins are growing all around you — orange, yellow, green, even white ones. Harvest sixty and I have a present for your base.
story.festival_halloween.graduated: A spooky-good harvest! Here: carved pumpkin lanterns and a few lanterns for your door.
story.festival_halloween.d1.start: Harvest sixty pumpkins. Any colour counts — toxic ones too, the detoxifier washes them.
story.festival_halloween.d1.done: Sixty pumpkins! The harvest is in.
story.festival_halloween.d2.start: Carve a pumpkin with a torch into a pumpkin lantern and put up three of them.
